string.name: objective
string.value: Search for evidence related to Account_001 and retrieve the details of EVID-MSG-001.

parameters.name: search_evidence
parameters.description: Search ACPIA synthetic evidence database by query string (e.g. Account_001). Requires parameter 'q'.

values.name: q
values.description: Query term to search evidence (e.g. Account_001)

parameters.name: get_evidence
parameters.description: Retrieve full ACPIA synthetic evidence details by evidence_id (e.g. EVID-MSG-001). Requires parameter 'evidence_id'.

options.systemMessage: You are the ACPIA Investigation AI Agent. Use search_evidence and get_evidence tools to retrieve the requested evidence details. Maximum iterations = 3. Stop after retrieving evidence.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{
  {
    "model": "qwen3:4b",
    "think": false,
    "messages": [
      {
        "role": "system",
        "content": "You are a strict JSON API engine. Output ONLY valid raw JSON adhering strictly to the requested schema. No explanation text."
      },
      {
        "role": "user",
        "content": "Analyze the following evidence retrieved by the Investigation Agent.

Retrieved Evidence:
" + JSON.stringify($json.output || $json.text || $json) + "

EVIDENCE GROUNDING RULES:
You may ONLY use facts explicitly present in the evidence provided to you.
NEVER invent:
- evidence IDs
- evidence types
- titles
- descriptions
- content
- entities
- locations
- events
- timestamps
- sources
- case IDs

If a fact is not present in the supplied evidence, do not assume it.
If the evidence is missing or incomplete, explicitly say:
"Insufficient evidence."

Return ONLY raw JSON adhering strictly to this schema:
{
  "evidence_id": "",
  "evidence_type": "",
  "title": "",
  "summary": "",
  "entities": [],
  "locations": [],
  "events": [],
  "timestamp": "",
  "source": "",
  "observations": []
}"
      }
    ],
    "stream": false,
    "options": {
      "temperature": 0.1,
      "num_ctx": 2048
    }
  }
}}
